code: data("wrld_simpl") SA <- c("Brazil", "Colombia",  "Argentina",         "Peru", "Venezuela", "Chile",         "Ecuador", "Bolivia", "Paraguay",         "Uruguay", "Guyana", "Suriname",         "French Guiana") south_ame <- wrld_simpl[wrld_simpl$NAME %in% SA, ] ggplot(data = south_ame) +   geom_sf() +   geom_sf_text(aes(label = ISO3)) +   theme_bw() PAM_pol <- lets.addpoly(PAM, south_ame, "NAME") head(PAM_pol) vars_col <- (ncol(PAM$P) + 1):ncol(PAM_pol) n <- length(vars_col) rich_count <- numeric(n) for (i in 1:n) {   rich_count[i] <- sum(colSums(PAM$P[PAM_pol[, vars_col[i]] > 0,                                      -(1:2)]) > 0) } labs <- as.factor(colnames(PAM_pol)[vars_col]) names(rich_count) <- labs mpg <- data.frame("Richness" = rich_count, "Country" = as.factor(labs)) g <- ggplot(mpg, aes(labs, Richness)) g + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + labs(x = "") +   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

Records grouped spatial clusters using [dbscan::dbscan()]. buffered concave hull constructed independently cluster using [sf::st_concave_hull()]. DBSCAN noise (label 0) omitted. Buffers hull computed local azimuthal equidistant projection centered using circular mean longitude. regional range estimator; metric distortion increases clusters extending far center. default `min_pts = 1` positive `buf`, even one unique occurrence produces buffered polygon (approximately `2 * buf` radius masking). Two-point collinear clusters also supported. Repeated records one location count one occurrence rounding. Higher `min_pts` still applies: isolated points classified noise omitted, mask can remove entire buffered range. `buf = 0`, clusters polygonal area omitted. Ranges masks split antimeridian Cartesian overlays longitude/latitude coordinates. overlays follow mapped edges mask, rather interpreting S2 great-circle arcs. distance buffer calculated degrees, caller's S2 setting unchanged. Missing species invalid coordinates dropped warning; `crop_shp` must known CRS. resulting polygons subsequently combined `crop_shp`. `intersection = TRUE`, portion overlapping `crop_shp` retained. can used, example, restrict terrestrial species ranges land areas. `intersection = FALSE`, portion overlapping `crop_shp` removed. can used remove land polygons ranges marine species. choice `eps_m`, `ratio`, `buf` can substantially influence resulting range geometry reflect spatial scale, sampling properties, biological characteristics study system.
